name: explainer
description: Skills for explaining things to humans who can't keep up with coding agents: persona-calibrated crash courses and books whose claims and figures are verified by tools.

plugins.name: explainer
plugins.description: Seven skills: explainer (a persona-calibrated crash course with tool-verified claims and figures; Mermaid / D2 / SVG / HTML figures rendered, checked for overlaps and arrow readability, compared across layouts and fixed by eye; Iconify icons), explainer-book (chaptered learning material with objectives, concept order, reading budgets and executed exercises), first-reader (simulated beta readers: skim gate, no-lookahead timed reads, recall test; bundled from awesome-llm-apps, Apache-2.0), and from vlmkit: explain-with-anim and explanatory-animation (checked vlmkit-anim figures and animations), d2-diagram (D2 / TALA held to a fact sheet) and d2-slides (D2 decks checked with vlmkit gates).
